formulas.ascii: ell = min(activeLevel[0], levelCounts.length - 1); status.count = levelCounts[ell]; firstRow = levelFirstRows[ell] (zero offsets by default). Optional drawArguments[1] = status.count and drawArguments[3] = firstRow; the other draw words are untouched.

snapshots.name: levelCounts
snapshots.meaning: occupied cells per pyramid level, finest (zoom 18) first

snapshots.name: activeLevel
snapshots.meaning: active level index (0 = zoom 18, 1 = zoom 17, 2 = zoom 16)

snapshots.name: selectedCount
snapshots.meaning: occupied cells of the selected level

snapshots.name: selectedFirstRow
snapshots.meaning: first row of the selected level in its buffer (0: one buffer per level)

snapshots.name: level1Cells
snapshots.meaning: zoom-17 Quadbin cell key as (low, high) uint32 words

snapshots.name: boundaries
snapshots.meaning: the selected zoom-17 level valued by place count; boundaries from GPUCellGeometry for display
